import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

def draw_thinking_stickman(frame_number):
    width, height = 1920, 1080
    img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), '#00FF00')
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    
    # Draw blackboard
    board_x, board_y = 100, 100
    board_w, board_h = 1300, 700
    # Board frame
    draw.rectangle([board_x-20, board_y-20, board_x+board_w+20, board_y+board_h+20], fill='#5C4033')
    # Board surface
    draw.rectangle([board_x, board_y, board_x+board_w, board_y+board_h], fill='#2F4F4F')
    
    # Blackboard content (Optional: some complex math or thinking diagram)
    draw.text((board_x + 100, board_y + 100), "E = mc^2\n\n? = ...", fill='white', font=None, size=50) # Fallback if font missing, ImageFont.load_default() is used usually
    # Drawing some chalk lines
    draw.line([(board_x+100, board_y+300), (board_x+400, board_y+300)], fill='white', width=5)
    draw.line([(board_x+100, board_y+350), (board_x+300, board_y+450)], fill='white', width=5)
    
    # Stickman position
    cx, cy = 1600, 400
    head_r = 80
    
    # Head
    draw.ellipse([cx-head_r, cy-head_r, cx+head_r, cy+head_r], outline='black', width=10, fill='#00FF00')
    
    # Thinking Expression
    # Eyes looking up and left
    eye_r = 8
    draw.ellipse([cx-30-eye_r, cy-20-eye_r, cx-30+eye_r, cy-20+eye_r], fill='black')
    draw.ellipse([cx+10-eye_r, cy-20-eye_r, cx+10+eye_r, cy-20+eye_r], fill='black')
    
    # Eyebrows (One raised, one lowered)
    draw.line([(cx-45, cy-40), (cx-15, cy-35)], fill='black', width=6) # Left eyebrow lowered
    draw.line([(cx+5, cy-45), (cx+35, cy-55)], fill='black', width=6) # Right eyebrow raised
    
    # Mouth (small, slightly to the side)
    draw.arc([cx-15, cy+30, cx+5, cy+40], 0, 180, fill='black', width=5)
    
    # Body
    body_top_y = cy + head_r
    body_bottom_y = body_top_y + 250
    draw.line([(cx, body_top_y), (cx, body_bottom_y)], fill='black', width=10)
    
    # Legs
    draw.line([(cx, body_bottom_y), (cx-80, body_bottom_y+250)], fill='black', width=10)
    draw.line([(cx, body_bottom_y), (cx+80, body_bottom_y+250)], fill='black', width=10)
    
    # Left Arm (Resting on hip or holding chalk down)
    shoulder_y = body_top_y + 40
    left_elbow = (cx - 80, shoulder_y + 80)
    left_hand = (cx - 30, shoulder_y + 160)
    draw.line([(cx, shoulder_y), left_elbow, left_hand], fill='black', width=10, joint="curve")
    
    # Right Arm (Tapping chin animation)
    # Frame index 271 to 360 corresponds to t=0 to 89
    t = frame_number - 271
    # tapping speed
    tap_offset = math.sin(t * 0.4) * 15
    
    right_elbow = (cx + 120, shoulder_y + 100 + tap_offset * 0.3)
    right_hand = (cx + 30, body_top_y - 10 + tap_offset)
    
    draw.line([(cx, shoulder_y), right_elbow, right_hand], fill='black', width=10, joint="curve")
    
    # Fingers tapping
    draw.line([right_hand, (right_hand[0]-10, right_hand[1]-15)], fill='black', width=6)
    draw.line([right_hand, (right_hand[0]-5, right_hand[1]-20)], fill='black', width=6)
    
    # Thinking bubbles
    bubble_x, bubble_y = cx + 80, cy - 120
    draw.ellipse([bubble_x, bubble_y, bubble_x+20, bubble_y+20], outline='black', width=4, fill='#00FF00')
    draw.ellipse([bubble_x+30, bubble_y-40, bubble_x+60, bubble_y-10], outline='black', width=4, fill='#00FF00')
    draw.ellipse([bubble_x+70, bubble_y-120, bubble_x+200, bubble_y-30], outline='black', width=4, fill='#00FF00')
    # Question mark inside big bubble
    draw.text((bubble_x + 115, bubble_y - 100), "?", fill='black', size=60) # Note: size might not work with default font but PIL draws it anyway
    # Draw question mark manually just in case
    draw.arc([bubble_x+115, bubble_y-100, bubble_x+145, bubble_y-70], 180, 0, fill='black', width=5)
    draw.line([(bubble_x+145, bubble_y-85), (bubble_x+145, bubble_y-75), (bubble_x+130, bubble_y-75), (bubble_x+130, bubble_y-60)], fill='black', width=5)
    draw.ellipse([bubble_x+126, bubble_y-50, bubble_x+134, bubble_y-42], fill='black')

    return img

def main():
    output_dir = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\stickman_master_asset"
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    for frame_idx in range(271, 361):
        img = draw_thinking_stickman(frame_idx)
        filename = f"frame_{frame_idx}.png"
        filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, filename)
        img.save(filepath)
        print(f"Saved {filepath}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
